{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the number of valid age entries (excluding -1)
valid_age_count = (df['customer_age'] != -1).sum()

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 values (invalid/missing)
mean_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required values
print(f'Number of customers with valid age: {valid_age_count}')
print(f'Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age}')"}
